column3: {([ Ahhhh! I just know that I'm going to do terribly in this tournament. I feel like Headmaster Eoghan never thinks about me or how I feel. . . . ])}
{([ Ugh. . . . I guess we'll just have to see how this goes. . . . ])}

{([ Well, here we go. . . Jade tried to pay Eoghan to stop the festival. . . She said I'm just not ready for something like this, and that it's better if the whole town get that on full display. . . curse this, man. This sucks. . . ])}

{([*<`DISPLAY EMOJIS`<`0`><`0>>* I knew I would just embarrass myself out there, and everyone just went and let me do it. Jade didn't even say goodbye to me, oh my oneness. . . I feel so worthless. . . ])}
{([*<`DISPLAY EMOJIS`<`0>`<`0>>* Well, I still lost, but I had a lot of fun. I feel like I'm starting to figure out what Thornton told us that one time about good swaps and bad swaps. . . . )}
